write a key the contract does not publish
move a recommendation past draft with a blocking gap or no card
occupy sent_by, waived_by, accepted_by or decided_by
stays_with_person: recording and transcription consent on the call
the responsible-lending assessment and the not-unsuitable decision
the recommendation issued to the client
accepting a lender-policy change into the live library
any statement to the client that a document has been certified, verified or approved

with_us.note: No hosted product. The live write into the network's own CRM tenant, against a dated panel library it controls, is the step not to hand-roll, and it is quoted as a scoped build.

checks.title: Disclosure and consent are recorded before the first field
Verbatim is stored before any field is filled
Only published field keys are writable, and completeness is computed
Anything with a lookup is resolved, read back, and written as resolved
One live file per client, updated and never duplicated
Every blocking gap is a task with an owner and a due date, raised once
Lender policy is a cited answer, never a recalled one
A retired clause cannot answer, and a new one answers only once a person accepts it
A recommendation cannot leave draft with a blocking gap or no card, and is sent by a person
Coaching cites a span or a clause, and breach_suspect goes to a named person
Recording, transcript, extracts, writes, cards, tasks and coaching are retrievable together
With the library detached, the assistant declines
